When a couple of gruesome killings take place in the city, ACP Jay Azad is brought in to nab the murderer, never mind his motive.

data.title: Cobalt Blue
data.overview: When an aspiring author and his free-spirited sister both fall for the enigmatic paying guest at their home, ensuing events rock their traditional family.

data.title: The Underbug
data.overview: As India is ravaged by sectarian violence on the eve of its Independence Day, two rioters take refuge in an abandoned house. An eerie presence in the house, however, haunts the men to the edge of sanity.

data.title: Haryana
data.overview: Follows three brothers from Haryana - Mahender, Jaibeer, and Jugnu. Mahender, the oldest, has been too busy taking care of everyone to think of his own love life. Jaibeer struggles to confess his love for a girl in his college. Jugnu falls madly in love with Alia Bhatt and decides to travel to Mumbai to ask for her hand.

data.title: Freddy
data.overview: Introverted and awkward Dr. Freddy Ginwala desperately searches for a soulmate. When he finally finds her, the relationship becomes as painful as a root canal.

data.title: Bhaiyya Ji
data.overview: After his younger brother is tragically killed over a petty argument, a feared and retired criminal Bhaiyya Ji, sets out to seek justice against the powerful Gujjar responsible, mobilizing his loyal comrades and igniting a wave of vengeance that threatens to shake the criminal underworld.

data.title: Dedh Bigha Zameen
data.overview: Anil, a 28-year-old wheat seller, lives with his wife, mother, and sister. Excited for his sister Neha's marriage to Ajay, a soon-to-be civil servant, Anil agrees to a dowry. To fund it, he plans to sell his late father's land, only to find it's under litigation by MLA Amar Singh.

data.title: Lakadbaggha
data.overview: An animal loving vigilante Arjun Bakshi unearths the fact that an underground illegal animal trade cell functions from Kolkata port. On investigating he chances upon a rare species of the Indian Striped Hyena (Lakadbaggha).Will he be able to reunite with his dog while also helping other animals?

data.title: Bhagwat - Chapter One: Raakshas
data.overview: A seemingly simple case of a missing girl, Poonam, puts Inspector Vishwas Bhagwat on a chase to find the culprit behind a sinister trail of disappearing girls. What happens next?

data.title: Mili
data.overview: Mili Naudiyal, a nursing graduate is planning to move to Canada. She takes up a job at a food outlet for the time being but her sudden disappearance without a clue leaves her loved ones in a desperate search for her in this survival drama.

data.title: Badhaai Do
data.overview: A gay cop and a lesbian teacher enter a sham marriage to pacify their families but find that relationships — both real and fake — aren't all that easy.

data.title: Toolsidas Junior
data.overview: A young boy seeks to master the game of snooker to defend his father’s legacy after a humiliating loss. But first, he’ll need help from a hardened pro.

data.title: Scammy Boys
data.overview: Scammy Boys,  With big dreams of money & fame, Pankaj & Piyush (Scammy) try to scam people to get a sum amount & live there life lavishly, while executing a scam they encounter a greedy policeman, Joshi who ruins their life by getting them involved in a drug cartel where their lives are completely changed & hassled. They try to make several plans to escape & lead a normal life, but the circumstances land them in a very different situation.

data.title: Dammy
data.overview: A young tribal man living in rural Madhya Pradesh. Naive and innocent, he is married to the love of his life, a tribal girl who shares his own name -- Suman.  Suman loses his wife to an accident. The lady dies; the baby is alive.  Suman is shattered beyond measure. Suman comes back to his tribal village with the infant, Thippu, but finds it extremely difficult to attend to the needs of the little one, who obviously misses a mother’s care. Finally, Suman decides to do the impossible!

data.title: Jayeshbhai Jordaar
data.overview: A non-confrontational Jayesh decides to defy his patriarchal family and flee with his pregnant wife Mudra to save their unborn daughter from foeticide. A screwball, hilarious chase begins as Jayesh's father assembles all his might to nab them. Will this unlikely hero manage to create a safe and equal haven for his daughter?

data.title: The Bhootnii
data.overview: The Virgin Tree, based in the heart of St. Vincent's College, is home to a spirit who awakens every Valentine's Day  in response to the longing for true love. As strange incidents multiply, the Virgin Tree becomes a place of dread,  the authorities call in a veteran para-physicist to confront the entity.

data.title: Nafratein
data.overview: Nafratein depicts the story of Karan, a young rebel, torn between rage and love, as he battles the turmoil within and the world around him.

data.title: U Shape Ki Gully
data.overview: The story revolves around a U-shaped alleyway in Lucknow, India, where various individuals reside. Mirza is a gentle and poetic man who runs a Tea and Kebab Stall. Hariya, a mischievous young man who develops one-sided feelings for Shabbo, a strong and outspoken young woman.

data.title: Lakeerein
data.overview: Lakeerein tells the powerful story of Kavya, who seeks justice against her husband for marital rape, a deeply troubling issue often overlooked due to societal misconceptions about consent in marriage.

data.title: Repulsive
data.overview: Barkha—a young smalltown woman—tries to make it as a dancer in Mumbai, but pays a heavy price for the freedom offered by the big city to experiment with her own sexuality.

data.title: Mumbai Saga
data.overview: The film, set in the 1980s and 90s, chronicles the transformation of Bombay to Mumbai. The story is a cat and mouse game between a deadly don, Amartya Rao, who doesn’t think twice before killing, and there’s nobody who could stop him and a cop, who is dogging his every step.

data.title: Quickie
data.overview: Quickie is a Bollywood comedy movie touted to be a teenage love story.

data.title: The Face of the Faceless
data.overview: Based on Sr. Rani Maria, this tale depicts the trials and tribulations of a woman who rose above the boundaries of her religion, realized the universal oneness, and committed her life to women's empowerment.

data.title: ICU
data.overview: After spending several years trying to distance herself from her childhood and her father, Kia is forced to return. Her father is in critical condition and could pass away at any second; her sister and her mother insist that her last words to him should be a fond goodbye. Kia has to decide what her last few words to her father will be.

data.title: Purush
data.overview: Purush is a Hindi play starring Ashutosh Rana, Gulki Joshi, Paromita Chatterjee and Deepak Qazir.  The play showcases the evils of the Indian patriarchal society. Ambika, a victim of the male dominated society fights not only herself but also for other women.

data.title: Rani Rani Rani
data.overview: A caretaker is trapped in a time loop with her husband on one hand, and his brother and ruthless sister-in-law on the other.

data.title: Mandali
data.overview: Mandali mirrors the journey of a man and his struggle to uphold righteousness in times of diminishing social conscience and the downfall of cultural and traditional values through the protagonist. Purshottam Chaubey aka Puru is a peon in an intermediate college in Mathura in Uttar Pradesh. He plays the role of Lord Laxmana along with his cousin Sitaram Chaubey who plays the role of Lord Rama in the Ramleela Mandali, run by his uncle Ramsevak Chaubey. Their life takes a blow when during a performance they have to leave midway because of Sitaram’s indulgence and addiction to drugs. Not being able to withstand the humiliation, and guilty of ruining God’s name, Ramsevak leaves performing in the Ramleela forever. Puru confronts Ramsevak on his escapist approach and condemns his decision to withdraw while beginning a journey of struggle to bring back his family on stage with dignity.

data.title: Aakhri Safar
data.overview: When an auto-rickshaw cab driver meets an unknown lady asking for a ride to her home.

data.title: 2bhk
data.overview: 2 flatmates unfold the layers of their relationship on a random Sunday afternoon after they encounter a power cut.

data.title: Aalingan
data.overview: Paavni, A young girl torn between traditional upbringing and modern exposure seeks acceptance on her new found identity from her emotionally estranged father. But her quest meets an unexpected end as she uncovers some uncomfortable truths.

data.title: Dono
data.overview: The film explores modern relationships and is set against the backdrop of a lavish destination wedding.

data.title: Pakka
data.overview: Four gay Indian friends share an unbreakable bond on a Dutch cricket field. But when one agrees to an arranged marriage in India, their chosen family begins to unravel.

data.title: Mamta Child Factory
data.overview: Two small-town real estate agents help a city doctor establish a surrogacy hospital, battling local prejudices and traditional mindsets in their conservative community.

data.title: The Moon
data.overview: Under the glow of a full moon, a romantic and a cynic argue about its beauty. But as the banter turns heated, things become personal, deepening the mystery of their connection.

data.title: Suburban Tale
data.overview: Radhika is not having a good weekend. She’s on the verge of losing her crappy job for a shady credit card company, she can’t pay rent, and she has to go home for her sister’s wedding despite being estranged from the family. Once she arrives, it only gets worse. Her family is hiding a young boy possessed by a demon, and they expect her to help keep him secret from their, soon-to-be, very wealthy in-laws. As Radhika loses control of the demonic child and begins to show signs of possession herself, both her family and her past race toward an inevitably violent conclusion.

data.title: Meenakshi Sundareshwar
data.overview: Forced to live apart due to a unique job prospect, two newlyweds face the hassles, hiccups — and hilarity — that arise from their long-distance marriage.

data.title: Kakuda
data.overview: When her husband Sunny gets cursed by the terrifying ghost, Kakuda, Indira joins hands with a ghost hunter to find a solution.

data.title: Fukrey 3
data.overview: In the third installment, the Fukras plan to take over Delhi, and run for city elections. However, they have no money and so they take on an international job to make a quick buck, which changes their lives forever. In the first two films, we saw them using dreams, then premonitions to make money but now they’ve been gifted with a new & unique talent which is going to make them millionaires.

data.title: Indian Institute of Zombies
data.overview: At an elite engineering campus, students must survive a sudden zombie outbreak while navigating academic pressures and social hierarchies, blending horror with comedy and biting satire of privilege and competition.

data.title: Adbhut
data.overview: Follows Diana who doesn't believe in ghosts or supernatural power. But when she feels something strange happening on a regular basis, she reaches out to Nawaz for help.

data.title: Shukranu
data.overview: Set in Delhi/UP/Haryana, SHUKRANU is a comic take on the darkest phases of Indian democracy through the encounters of a would-be groom who is forcefully sterilized just days before his much-awaited marriage.

data.title: The Ladykiller
data.overview: When a small-town playboy falls in love for a dangerous girl, they embark on a journey of a dangerous romance.

data.title: X Zone
data.overview: A group of friends plan a holiday at a lonely farmhouse but their vacation soon turns into a nightmare when they realise the bungalow is haunted. Will they escape?

data.title: Whispers of a Qareen
data.overview: Father and sister died in a landslide. Between reality and fantasy, twelve-year-old Jahaan is searching for a place where the dead exist.

data.title: Ek Chatur Naar
data.overview: Abhishek Verma, a fund consultant, gets trapped in a web of lies, deception and blackmail after a good-for-nothing but cunning woman, failing to make ends meet, gets her hands on his phone, which lets slip more than anyone should know, forcing him to comply.

data.title: Eetha
data.overview: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

data.title: Pretend Play
data.overview: Pretend Play follows a young content creator documenting his mother’s fractured memory, transforming personal pain into educational and emotional online content in pursuit of visibility and digital relevance.

data.title: Kartam Bhugtam
data.overview: The story delves into the ancient truths of astrology and karma, exploring how every action has a certain reaction, echoing the age-old phrase 'as you sow, so shall you reap.

data.title: OUTCAST
data.overview: This film traces the inspiring journey of Aaysha Koli, a transwoman who overcame relentless harassment and discrimination from childhood to adulthood. From being bullied at school to facing societal rejection, Aaysha never gave up. Instead, she stood tall against all odds, transforming her life and identity with resilience and hope. Today, Aaysha is an artist and a proud member of the Aravani Art Project. Outcast tells her story of courage and self-discovery—from being Aakash Koli to becoming Aaysha Koli.

data.title: Jogi
data.overview: Amid tension in 1980s India, three friends of different faiths unite in a noble yet dangerous effort to save hundreds in their town.

data.title: #Homecoming
data.overview: A group of "friends" and "misfits", who had formed a popular yet short-lived youth theatre group, reunite for the first time after seven years on an eventful Durga Pujo night at their old rehearsal space, a bungalow which is about to be converted into Kolkata's first five-star heritage hotel by the Ganges.

data.title: Karamati Paudha
data.overview: Nine-year-old Subbu steals the branch of a magical plant from his classmate Montu's house, which Montu wants to get back.

data.title: Return Ticket
data.overview: Kunal endeavours indefatigably to win his mother's endearment but is stunned to know that he is a byproduct of a gang rape and he resembles one of the assailants. Now spruced up to take revenge against the savages who are now bigtime officials who remain assured that having no traces of a crime of yore can never stop them.

data.title: Nayyi Navelli
data.overview: A new bride's arrival turns a turbulent household in Meerut into a picture of domestic harmony, until her brother-in-law grows convinced that his seemingly perfect sister-in-law is secretly a witch.

data.title: Janhit Mein Jaari
data.overview: A small-town girl from MP, Manokamna, gets a decent-paying job. But the work requires her to sell condoms. Will she be able to voice her beliefs while balancing her responsibilities and society?

data.title: Pintu Ki Pappi
data.overview: A man starts a lucrative business with his uncle when they realise he has a special power.

data.title: India Lockdown
data.overview: The Indian government announces a country-wide lockdown for 21 days due to the pandemic. India Lockdown encapsulates the story of four out of lakhs of individuals whose lives came to a standstill.

data.title: Crakk: Jeetega... Toh Jiyegaa
data.overview: It follows the journey of a man from the slums of Mumbai to the world of extreme underground sports.

data.title: Mister Mummy
data.overview: Amol, a cranky PT teacher and his wife Gugloo have opposing choices when it comes to children but destiny has something else planned for the childhood sweethearts.

data.title: Chhalaang
data.overview: Chhalaang humorously addresses the value of Sports Education in the school curriculum. It follows a hilarious, yet an inspirational journey of a typical PT Master from a semi government-funded school in Northern India, Montu, for whom it’s just a job and is forced to do what he has never done - Teach.

data.title: Googly Gumm Hai
data.overview: Googly, a carefree young woman and her lover, Shorya, take a romantic trip to Dharamshala. At the airport they are received by their tour-guide, Ranga, who appears to be somewhat disturbed upon hearing Googly’s name. An incomprehensible sadness betrays Ranga’s cool demeanor. Googly is awestruck by the beauty of sunset amidst the snow-capped mountains and is inspired to go hiking.  Shorya, though initially reluctant, finally yields. They set out on their trek and the appalling beauty of the mountains overwhelms them. In a moment of romantic fervour, Shorya slips and falls off the cliff and gets stuck on a crest at the edge of a steep fall. Hereafter, the movie follows Googly and Ranga on their individual rescue missions-- Googly’s to save Shorya and Ranga’s to find Googly. And amidst all this, flitting on and off the screen, is a ghastly figure in the cave whom Shorya dismisses as a figment of his own imagination

data.title: Pyaar Ishq aur Possession
data.overview: Lakshya, an acclaimed painter, faces marital strife as his wife Palak craves luxury, clashing with his simple lifestyle. Alisha, a wealthy art promoter, complicates matters, igniting lies and betrayals.

data.title: Vakeel Babu
data.overview: A young lawyer, distracted with chasing success through his digital video channel, is approached online by an anonymous female victim with a powerful abuser. Will he do justice to the challenge? The film traces the journey of Shiraz Hassan as he rediscovers his purpose in the justice system.

data.title: Uttar Da Puttar
data.overview: Vastu, destiny and daily life, where unexpected events challenge beliefs about luck, direction and the power to shape your own future.

data.title: Kaagaz
data.overview: Kaagaz (transl. Paper) is a biographical drama about a farmer, Lal Bihari's 19-year struggle to make himself come alive again when he is declared dead in Government records by interests keen to take over his assets.

data.title: Shabaash Mithu
data.overview: From child prodigy to trailblazing captain, Indian women's cricket icon Mithali Raj navigates highs and lows of professional career. A story of a young girl's determination and stance against discrimination, about her spirit, passion, courage, and her dreams.

data.title: Shadow Assassins
data.overview: A film by Nilaanjan Reeta Datta.

data.title: Lost & Found in Kumbh
data.overview: When half-brothers Luke (8) and Rags (13) are separated from their parents amid the immense crowds of Mahakumbh, their disappearance sparks a frantic search. The journey leads to exploration of family, identity, and the unexpected paths that lead us home.

data.title: Full Plate
data.overview: Amreen had been a homemaker for 18 years until a freak accident during Holi left her husband, Imtiaz crippled for life. Challenged with the responsibility to run the house and educate three kids, Amreen has to work. Her neighbour, Sarita, who cooks, she is away for two months, so Amreen jumps at the opportunity despite her husband's unwillingness. But her Muslim identity is a major deterrent.

data.title: Purvanchal Diaries
data.overview: Know About This?

data.title: Logout
data.overview: Pratyush, a social media influencer who is about to reach his biggest milestone in terms of followers to land a deal with a brand, loses his phone to a fan obsessed with him. Trapped in his own house without his phone, Pratyush must find a way to reclaim his identity and his career.

data.title: Chu Kat Gaya
data.overview: A Group Of 4 Youngsters One Evening Tempted By Watching Adult Films Decide To Call An Escort To Their Home. Excited And Eagerly Waiting For Her, They All Start To Imagine Her Before She Even Arrives. Upon Arriving She Makes Her Charges Very Clear And Waits For Them In The Bedroom And They Have To Decide Who Is Going First. Watch The Fun As They All Want To Show Off Their Manhood In Front Of Each Other And What Goes Up And Down In The Bedroom.

data.title: Sandeep Aur Pinky Faraar
data.overview: Sandeep, a bank executive & Pinky, a suspended cop, are marked for a kill. Phones tapped, accounts blocked, they escape but escaping is not freedom.

data.title: The Blue Bicycle
data.overview: Battling cold, hunger, and uncertainty, two siblings navigate the city's challenges in search of a better life. Hasan and Khushbu, escape from their refugee camp on a chilling winter night to chase their dream bicycle in the city.

data.title: Gumraah
data.overview: A murder investigation becomes complicated after the cops discover a pair of lookalike suspects.

data.title: Forensic
data.overview: Little girls begin to disappear and their bodies are found soon after in the town of Mussoorie. Police officer Megha and forensic officer Johnny join hands to nab the killer.

data.title: Online Ishq
data.overview: Suspecting her boyfriend of infidelity, She involves another woman who is her best friend to test his faithfulness. While his girlfriend is away her friend connects with him through social media and soon turns in to dating and romance, She indulges his deepest fantasies. Soon, the relationships between all three intensify as his girlfriend is set to return. Watch the drama and learn that Love should never be Judged

data.title: Raat Akeli Hai
data.overview: When a newly married landlord is murdered, a misfit cop’s investigation is complicated by the victim’s secretive family and his own conflicted heart.

data.title: Operation Mayfair
data.overview: A serial killer strikes back in London after laying low for three years.  Amar, the investigating detective has since resigned from the job but is brought back to crack the case. Amar decides to return and resolve the case once and for all.

data.title: Zara Hatke Zara Bachke
data.overview: Kapil and Somya fall in love, get married and are happily living in a joint family. However, soon the love fades away and the couple is on the verge of a divorce, but not a real one as a twist awaits the two families.

data.title: Aryabhatt Ka Zero
data.overview: A directionless young man from a middle-class family struggles to find his place in a world that has already written him off. As life tests his resilience, he embarks on a heartfelt journey of self-discovery, hope, and finding the courage to believe in himself.

data.title: Dange
data.overview: Former friends Xavier and Yuva meet again in college as adversaries when their respective cohorts come to blows during their annual cultural festival.

data.title: Ankahi Kahaniya
data.overview: As big city life buzzes around them, lonely souls discover surprising sources of connection and companionship in three tales of love, loss and longing.

data.title: Kaalidhar Laapata
data.overview: An ageing Kaalidhar escapes his family after overhearing their plans to abandon him. He meets the free-spirited Ballu, and they embark on an adventure to tick things off Kaalidhar's bucket list.

data.title: Sarzameen
data.overview: Set in Kashmir, the film follows an Indian Army officer who discovers that his estranged son has joined a militant group.

data.title: Jackson Halt
data.overview: A UK based NRI visit india, while returning goes to a remote station run by psychopath station master.

data.title: Blurr
data.overview: With progressive blindness setting in, Gayatri has to find answers to her twin sister's unlikely death. As the lines of reality keep getting blurred, is she ready to look the truth in the eye?

data.title: 12 “o” CLOCK
data.overview: Aahuti a metaphysics student from Delhi, shifts to Mumbai to be close to her fiancee, what happens next when she discovers the apartment she lives in is haunted.

data.title: Despatch
data.overview: Determined to break the next big story and refashion his complicated personal life, Joy embarks on a relentless odyssey through the heart and gut of Mumbai.

data.title: Kaali Khuhi
data.overview: When a restless spirit curses a Punjab village that has a history of female infanticide, the town's fate lies in the hands of a 10-year old girl, Shivangi.

data.title: Maya
data.overview: Maya, a physiotherapist in her forties, relocates to the UK after a painful divorce and the loss of her ability to conceive. Living with her caring aunt Ammu, she withdraws emotionally and immerses herself in work. Her routine changes when she begins treating Mahesh, a stubborn sixty-year-old Marathi man recovering from a fracture. Initially hostile, Mahesh agrees to therapy after intervention from his son Siddharth, an optimistic widower and devoted father. As sessions progress, Mahesh's vulnerability emerges, and Maya saves his life twice. A quiet bond forms through shared loneliness, while Maya also feels drawn to Siddharth's warmth.

data.title: Krishna Aur Chitthi
data.overview: What happens when the "God of Cricket" and the Lord of the Universe reside under the same roof? Krishna Aur Chitthi is a soul-stirring family drama that explores the thin line between fandom and faith, proving that when an intention is pure, every prayer, whether addressed to Vaikuntha or Wankhede, reaches the same destination

data.title: Janki
data.overview: Raghu loves Janaki deeply but is unable to express his feelings. Meanwhile, Janaki`s marriage is arranged with Raghu`s brother. Will Raghu go against his brother to win her love?

data.title: Night Queen
data.overview: Forty-eight-year-old Lakshmikant Sharma lives in Old Lucknow with his wife, daughter and widowed mother, living a life that is the textbook definition of monotony. Except it isn’t. Lakshmi wants to wear Sarees, put on her favourite shade of pink lipstick and live like a woman.

data.title: Kofuku
data.overview: Sadaf meets a stranger in a Café in Mussoorie who insists that he would show her around. What lay ahead is a rendezvous that changed Sadaf's perspective on her life.

data.title: Hacker: Trust No One
data.overview: Danny was set to be rich with his new crypto currency until he was caught hacking finding himself and his girlfriend on a hit list.

data.title: Footfairy
data.overview: The plot is set in Mumbai, a city of dream and land of opportunities. The psychological crime thriller showcases an intriguing chase between a serial killer with a distinctive fetish and CBI officer named Gulshan. In the serial killer's point of view, the film explores the fugitive's darkest desire for momentary pleasure.

data.title: Chidiakhana
data.overview: It is a coming-of-age story of a Bihari boy who is embraced by residents of a Marathi Chawl due to his grit, imagination and especially his footballing skills.

data.title: Hurdang
data.overview: In the 1990s' Allahabad, a brash college student gets drawn into an uproar surrounding a critical bill that will affect India's education system.

data.title: While We Watched
data.overview: A turbulent newsroom drama that intimately chronicles the working days of broadcast journalist Ravish Kumar as he navigates a spiraling world of truth and disinformation.

data.title: Satyaprem Ki Katha
data.overview: A middle-class boy in Ahmedabad, Satyaprem falling in one-sided love with Katha, who is coping with her breakup with Tapan. Through the journey, they discover each other's life and complement in accomplishing what was left halfway.

data.title: Guns of Banaras
data.overview: In the process of getting back his beloved vehicle that gave him everything he needed, Guddu Shukla and his friends get into major trouble with the most dangerous criminals in Banaras.

data.title: 12x12
data.overview: A photographer who clicks the last photographs' of the dead at Varanasi's Manikarnika ghat goes on a journey through the periphery of the circle of life and death only to discover that his own death will be documented by his son through his old camera.

data.title: Halfpace
data.overview: When a bed-ridden teen discovers his online crush has been murdered, he investigates her death, leading him on a hunt to stop her killer before he strikes again.

data.title: Ramprasad Ki Tehrvi
data.overview: Ramprasad's entire family gathers under one roof for 13 days after his death, to perform and observe the Hindu traditions and rituals called the tehrvi. During the course, the family’s dynamics, politics, and insecurities come out, and then they realise that the importance of people and things are only evident in retrospect.

data.title: Loveyapa
data.overview: The madness after a couple exchanges their mobile phones and begins to unearth bitter truth about each other.

data.title: La Mer
data.overview: In a parched, post-apocalyptic world, a veteran scientist grapples with hope and despair amidst water scarcity.

data.title: Bewafa Sanam
data.overview: According to her father's wish, Sandhya marries Prem and moves to London. However, she begins to suspect Prem after seeing him together with a girl named Neha. Will Sandhya be able to save her marriage with Prem?

data.title: Ghoomer
data.overview: Anina, a young woman batting prodigy, loses her right hand in an unfortunate accident on the eve of her international cricketing debut. An unsympathetic, failed and frustrated cricketer enters her life, gives her a new dream and transforms her fate by the most innovative training, to make her play for the Indian cricket team again, as a bowler.

data.title: Monster
data.overview: Why does a little girl partake in such a heinous crime? A series of events unravel und we find out that there is no greater love than that of a parent. (ALTER)

data.title: Adheen
data.overview: Son and daughter aur called in by their father in home. The father lets them decide on who wants to keep their mother with them as both of them live separately. Father gives mother a poison and he lives the antidote for them to decide.

data.title: Welcome Wedding
data.overview: It is a light hearted surreal comedy target to attract masses and is a hilarious family entertainer. This bet then leads to many funny situations, twists and turns and finally son does win the bet however what had he done to win this is the high point of climax.

data.title: Bhagwan Bharose

data.title: Bandit Shakuntala
data.overview: Shakuntala grows up in poverty, part of the lowest cast in Indian society. At a young age she decides to improve her position and make a better life for herself through studying hard. But at the age of 12 she is brutally raped by the Chief of her village, humiliated and dishonored she is unable to get justice. Forced into an arranged marriage with a drunkard, the marriage doesn't last. But tragedy strikes again as she is gang raped again by the Chief together with a mob of villagers. When rescued by Nadeem, an outlaw bandit, she is taught the skills on how to avenge herself. Gun in hand she seeks revenge for everything she and other women like her, have had to endure. Her name instills dread and fear, but this is just the start of her journey for justice and retribution.

data.title: Dear Dia
data.overview: The movie Dear Dia is a Hindi remake of the super-hit Kannada film "Dia". The movie revolves around a love story between Mihika Kushwaha, Pruthvi Ambaar, and Ujjwal Sharma who are playing the lead actors. The film is directed by KS Ashoka, produced by Kamlesh Singh Kushwaha and will be released under the Netrix Entertainment Pvt Ltd banner. This musical youthful love story is driven through the music of Jubin Nautiyal, Shankar Mahadevan, Palak Muchhal and Jyotica Tangri.

data.title: Licence
data.overview: A fruit vendor, denied a gun licence due to his low status, stages a fake attack with his friends to get around the system. But as the investigation deepens, it reveals a darker, deeply personal motive tied to his past.

data.title: Kahani Rubberband Ki
data.overview: Kahani Rubberband Ki is an upcoming Hindi-language feature film produced and directed by Sarika Sanjot featuring Avika Gor, Pratik Gandhi, and Manish Raisinghan in lead roles.

data.title: Thar
data.overview: A mysterious stranger arrives in a village situated in the Thar desert and crosses paths with a veteran cop investigating a case of brutal killings.

data.title: Vilom
data.overview: Vilom, a lonely, isolated young man from India, is obsessed with becoming internet-famous and deeply confused about his sexuality. When he moves in with Amay, a dynamic, openly gay hairdresser, and Nivi, a beautiful struggling actress, he finds that they are both slowly falling in love with him. This sudden love triangle leads to even more confusion, forcing Vilom to examine his sexual and romantic wants and needs on an even deeper level. Meanwhile, societal pressures and prejudices are beginning to build just outside the walls of their home.

data.title: Thai Massage
data.overview: A typical middle-class 70-year-old widower, Atmaram Dubey, who has been celibate for decades, realises he will probably never have sex. This awakening catapults him into an outrageous journey of self-discovery defying societal norms.

data.title: Pyre
data.overview: In the Himalayan Mountain range, a rural village loses its inhabitants to the city’s allure while an elderly couple, Padam Singh and Tulsi, live in desolate isolation. Their days are filled with routine and occasional humour as they mask their loneliness. Their son’s absence gnaws at them, and when a letter arrives promising his return, it reignites their hearts with joy and anticipation. However, the reunion does not unfold as expected, shattering their hopes. As the film climaxes, the spectator is confronted with a more rueful plight, deeply engaging the audience’s empathy.

data.title: Three of Us
data.overview: Shailaja embarks on a confrontational journey with her husband and childhood-love as she finds herself at the cusp of her past, present and future. Stitched with a very delicate thread of emotions, this film is about love, loss, healing, awareness and liberation.

data.title: Virgin Bhanupriya

data.title: Pati Patni and Joe
data.overview: A black comedy that tests the facade of modernity that a man wears, when he stumbles upon a secret manuscript - a work in progress erotica being written by his domesticated wife, which may be more autobiographical than he initially thinks.

His struggle to stay relevant in front of his two sons finally ends when he rekindles his love for cooking through a kitty party. A bunch of merry women rekindle in Sharma, a passion for cooking and chutzpah in general, that help him find his true calling.

data.title: Gul Makai
data.overview: Fear is like an elastic band. You stretch the band inside of your mind and it keeps expanding, till one moment it snaps or you cut it for it to break. 'Gul Makai' is such a story, a story of courage that overcame fear and oppression. 'Gul Makai' accounts the courageous journey and struggle of Nobel laureate Malala Yousufzai, from her humble upbringing in the Swat Valley to her becoming the champion for free education to all. 'Gul Makai' is a small tribute to this lion hearted girl who is in every essence a global citizen championing a cause that transcends boundaries, caste, religion and geography.

data.title: KRISHNA ARJUN
data.overview: Krishna Arjun is Hemwant Tiwari’s second ambitious single-shot film, a gripping tale of brotherhood, betrayal, and redemption set in rural India.  After years of estrangement, Krishna returns to his native village determined to set things right. Haunted by the past and driven by a sense of responsibility, he seeks to reconnect with his innocent twin brother, Arjun. Unbeknownst to Krishna, Arjun has become an unwitting pawn in a dangerous political conspiracy, orchestrated by a corrupt local minister.  As events unfold in real time, captured in a seamless single take, Krishna races against time to uncover the truth and protect his brother before it's too late. Tensions rise, loyalties are tested, and hidden motives come to light in this powerful and immersive cinematic experience.  Krishna Arjun explores the strength of familial bonds in the face of manipulation and moral decay — all through the lens of a technically bold and emotionally charged narrative.

data.title: Kaamyaab

In this story it has been told that what is the emptiness in this person's personal life and how it is from society Fighting protecting the lives of others by fighting than. This story based on humanity of Hegira and shows problems in her lives.

Will they be able to do what Delhi Police has been trying for the last 12 months?

data.title: The River of Love
data.overview: A man who has forgotten his past (Raahi) meets a woman (Swara) who'd rather forget hers. He combines a great power for self-destruction and penitence with a desperate need for dignity. data.title: Dug Dug

data.title: Azad Bharath

data.title: Appu

data.title: Gandhi Godse Ek Yudh

data.title: Closets

A perfect satire to bring out the importance and acceptance of the LGBTQIA+ community in India in the current times, the film is a fun ride that leaves you with thinking about much more than it projects.

data.title: Captive
