data.title: Akkada Ammai Ikkada Abbai
data.overview: Akkada Ammai Ikkada Abbaai is a Telugu film. Directed by Nithin-Bharath. Starring pradeep machiraju and deepika pilli in the lead role.

data.title: Manasanamaha
data.overview: A young man muses on the nature of love, recounting three relationships from his past. The girls in his life resemble three different seasons, namely Chaitra (Spring), Varsha (Monsoon) & Seeta (Winter).

He hires a marriage bureau that arranges three match-making dates for him, with women from three different backgrounds. The marriage bureau’s owner sends her daughter Thupakula Satyabhama to pick up and accompany him to these dates. The two fall in love during this one-day trip but destiny has other plans for them.

data.title: Ramam Raghavam

data.title: Sita on the Road

data.title: O Pitta Katha
data.overview: Two men fall deeply in love with the same woman but when she suddenly gets kidnapped they get involved in the case to rescue her.

data.title: Cheema Prema Madhyalo Bhama
data.overview: An ant desires to become a human and when his wish comes true he gets involved in the complications of human relationships.

data.title: Rowdy Boys

Due to an incident in her college, Kavya decides to begin a live-in relationship with Akshay. Her classmate Vikram (Vikram Saahidev), who admires her, vows not to remain silent.

Hope only reappears in the form of Shravya, a no-nonsense single mother. However, just as Siddharth begins to rebuild his life and pursue a chance at love, his past resurfaces to threaten everything.

data.title: Drushyam 2

data.title: Vyooham
data.overview: Revolves around the sudden circumstances which rose around the sudden death of YSR and the subsequent plots which were weaved by various concerned.

data.title: Thank You Subbarao

data.title: Anaganaga

By contrast, his son is a responsible man who dreams of climbing up the ladder and making something of his life. The film explores how the clash of personalities results in problems down the road for this father-son duo.

data.title: First Day First Show

His quest turns even more intense when Laya, the girl of his dreams from his class, decides to watch the first show with him. Now, it turns into a race against time and upholding the word he had given to Laya.

data.title: Simbaa

data.title: Son Of

data.title: Game On
data.overview: A loser enters into a real time game to win which leads him to explore challenges and brings out the hidden secrets from his past.

After a chance meeting with Anjana, Murthy delves into the challenging and exciting process of becoming a DJ and ventures to Hyderabad to achieve his dream against all odds.

data.overview: An intriguing drama of an unidentified stranger terrorising a girl

data.title: Dheera

data.title: Prathinidhi 2
data.overview: Sequel of 2014's Political Drama "Prathinidhi".

data.overview: Three little kids from Vadamalapeta want to hunt down Dawood Ibrahim and claim prize money. An investigative reporter and her sidekicks want to bring down a child trafficking nexus. How does this motley crew cross paths?

data.title: Kota Bommali PS

Daily life within the fishing community  its hardships, traditions, and unspoken bonds, forms the backdrop of the narrative. When personal desires begin to clash with family expectations, the protagonist is forced to confront sacrifice, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Through moments of romance, conflict, and emotional depth, the film reveals the  strength of family ties and the resilience of a community that survives by trusting the sea and each other.

data.title: Joshua Imai Pol Kaakha
data.overview: A contract killer seeking a different profession is assigned to protect a high-profile speaker.

data.title: Murugesan +2
data.overview: Murugesan+2 is a darkly comic tale about Murugesan, a truck driver leading a secret double life with two families. When he is presumed dead after a severe accident, a promised settlement sparks a bitter feud between his wives and their families, each scheming for control of the money. Just as the battle turns vicious, Murugesan returns alive, only to become a burden to those who once mourned him. Faced with betrayal and greed, Murugesan and his disillusioned sons walk away, leaving behind a biting satire on family, loyalty, and the corrupting power of money.

data.title: Poochandi
data.overview: Thrill-seeking journalist Murugan heads to Malaysia to look for ordinary folks with odd stories, to be used as part of the true paranormal story collection he writes for a magazine. Everything goes well at first for him upon his arrival in Malaysia, that is until he encounters a supernatural experience that changes his life.

data.title: Aaradhana
data.overview: Maya, a dedicated and pregnant doctor, moves into a rural village with her husband Pradeep, a novelist seeking peace and inspiration for his next book. They hope for a fresh start in a calm and isolated environment.

data.title: Annapoorani
data.overview: A young girl from a conservative family aspires to become the best cook in India.

data.title: Kick
data.overview: A young advertisement director, who conducts business with models and entertainers, suddenly has the chance to take over the global corporation by masquerading as the fake son of a CEO. While being chased by investors who lost money because of his enterprise, he falls in love.

data.title: Rajini Gaang
data.overview: Rajini and Maina Elope From Their Village and End Up Hitching a Ride With a Stranger And a Petty Thief Whose Stolen Thali They Use for a Hurried Wedding. But Their New Life Takes a Bizarre Turn When Maina Becomes Possessed by the Ghost of Ponnarasi. Seeking Help From a Local Priest, Rajini Discovers That the Spirit Wants Revenge for a Past Betrayal Tied to the Thali. As Twists Unfold, Rajini and His Friends Must Uncover the Truth and Save Maina From the Vengeful Ghost’s Deception.

data.title: Piranthanaal Vazhthukal
data.overview: Anpu lives an alcoholic life, and one day his friends and family members take him alive to a graveyard and try to burn him to death with posthumous rituals. The film moves forward with a social commitment in a village setting, as he witnesses his own funeral.

data.title: Jigiri Dosthu
data.overview: Three Best Friends From Childhood - Vicky, Rishi and Loki. Vicky Aspires to Become a Scientist, Rishi Aspires to Become an Actor Whereas Loki Aspires to Just Enjoy Life and How Off in Front of His College Friends.  The Story Happens in One Day, the Day of Vicky's Birthday. On This Day, the Trio Plan to Go for an Outing to Mahabalipuram. En-route, They Witness a Girl Being Kidnapped by a Terrifying Gangster in a Running Car. Seeing the Kidnap, Rishi and Vicky Take a Vow to Save the Girl,  to Which Loki Doesn't Show Much Interest. How They Save the Girl From the Gangster Using Vicky's Technology Called  Terrorist Tracker Forms the Rest of the Story

data.title: Anantha
data.overview: An anthology film centered on the divine grace and miracles of Sri Sathya Sai Baba, showcasing how faith transforms lives, featuring stories of a mischievous man's redemption and a village facing floods, emphasizing universal love and divinity, not a specific religion

data.title: Yaadhum Oore Yaavarum Kelir
data.overview: A refugee struggles hard to find an identity for himself in order to accomplish his dreams.

data.title: Nesippaya
data.overview: Two lovers, separated by life's circumstances, are reunited by a tragic fate—a murder. Arjun, driven by his love for Diya, defies all odds, crosses boundaries, and braves the unknown to uncover the truth behind her tragic fate.

data.title: Chiyaangal
data.overview: Set against the backdrops of Meghamalai foothills in Theni, the story revolves around 7 aged persons, whose life is laden with nothing but disappointments. They are forsaken by their families, rejected off their needs. They’re left with nothing and are almost in a walking dead stage.

data.title: Virundhu
data.overview: Famous businessman John Kalathil dies by suicide. 6 months later, his wife Elizabeth meets a tragic accident. On her deathbed, she tasks auto driver Hemand to pass a secret to Comrade Balettan.

data.title: 4 Sorry
data.overview: An Anthology Drama film with 4 different situations with 4 different plots which involves emotion and feelings.

data.title: Kiss Me Idiot
data.overview: After damaging Veerat’s car by accident, college student Srileela agrees to work as his assistant for two months. During this time, she falls in love with him, but he sends her away before she confesses. Realizing his feelings later, Veerat tries to win her back. Will love succeed?

data.title: Boomer Uncle
data.overview: Nesam and his soon-to-be ex-wife, a foreigner named Amy, head to his neglected ancestral castle to fulfill a divorce agreement. Amy has a hidden agenda involving Nesam’s father’s scientific secrets. Meanwhile, Nesam’s old lackeys, Dawood, Bala and Thangadurai also converge on the mansion with their own plans. When a hologram of Oviya enters the picture, and Amy unleashes a “Franken-Hulk” monster with Robo Shankar’s head, the film abandons all attempts at coherence.

data.title: Pizza 3: The Mummy
data.overview: A restaurant owner experiences mysterious activities in his kitchen, only to discover a connection with the ghost haunting his place.

data.title: Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
data.overview: Two wily online scammers mend their fraudulent ways after meeting the girls of their dreams — until a deceitful discovery throws their world for a loop.

data.title: Friday
data.overview: Mani, a determined gangster seeking revenge for his brothers death, sets out to kill Jagan, a feared local don. But when his trusted ally Gopi jeopardizes the plan, Mani abandons the mission to protect him. Forced into hiding, Mani finally reveals the painful truth of how his brother was killed six months ago, setting the stage for a tense journey fueled by loyalty, loss and vengeance.

data.title: Mamakiki
data.overview: MaMaKiKi is a film about four friends who studied together in college. They meet at a reunion in college after 5 years of graduation. What has happened in everyone's lives in the 5 years forms the structure of the film.

data.title: Bioscope

data.title: Konjam Pesinaal Yenna
data.overview: Sanjana's feelings for her childhood crush Ajay reawaken through virtual interactions. They bond over phone calls during lockdown, forming a connection without traditional labels, but face hurdles in recognizing their emotions.

data.title: Miral
data.overview: A family with a past and trauma, encounters a series of strange incidences, in a car journey on their way home and runs into trouble in a windmills farm.

data.title: Naane Varuvean
data.overview: A father finds out that his teenager daughter is possessed, and the only way he can save her is by doing the ghost's bidding, which will mean an encounter with his long-separated twin - who happens to be a psycho killer.

data.title: Sabdham

data.title: Gangers

data.title: Thadayam Mudhal Adhyayam
data.overview: One of the crime scene turns out to be intriguing for the cop Mathivaanan which links to the series of previous murders with same pattern in the town. Further probing leads him into psychological distress before he gets his eyes on the devil for the intelligent battle.

data.title: Demonte Colony 2
data.overview: Debbie attempts to contact the spirit of her deceased husband Sam, she inadvertently contacts Srinivasan, who had just died. This contact saves his life but leaves him in a coma for years. Later, Debbie unravels mystery about Lord Demonte sacrificing people and enslaves their spirits. Can Debbie break this cycle and help Srinivasan to wake up from his coma?

data.title: Yaadhumagi Nindraai
data.overview: This is based on several true stories that happen in the daily lives of background dancers. This is the first film in Tamil to give an insight into the lives of the background dancers and the dreams and aspirations they cherish. The film follows the story of a young school going girl, forced to take up dancing to make the ends meet for her family. Her dreams and aspirations are simple, but the realities of life is a lot more harsh than what one can imagine. This is a story that travels over 2 decades of the life of one such dancer Thamarai and the various people she meets and travels with. This is a story of hope, it's a story of a young girl, it's a story that has to be experienced to be cherished. It's a story that stays with you for a long time.

data.title: Vattakhanal
data.overview: Kathiravan raises three orphans—Sathya, Surya, and Shiva—as his own, grooming them to unknowingly support his illegal mushroom drug empire. Despite being used as pawns, the trio remains loyal out of love. After killing his former boss and seizing control of the business, Kathiravan earns the wrath of Radha, the boss’s widow, who plots revenge. Meanwhile, Varsha, a local woman and love interest of Sathya, plans to transfer her estate to its workers. Threatened by this, Kathiravan manipulates the employees, turning them against her. As Varsha’s life hangs in the balance, Sathya and Radha must confront Kathiravan—leading to a climactic reckoning.

data.title: Vaazhai
data.overview: A twelve-year-old bright schoolboy, Sivanandhan, his mother, sister, and with his friend Sekhar works during his school holidays carrying banana stalks, a task he dreads. As he navigates life's challenges, poverty, friendship, and the challenges of growing up, Sivanandhan’s determination is tested by the harsh realities of life.

data.title: Gargi
data.overview: When a schoolteacher's father is arrested for the rape of a 10-year-old girl, the media storm surrounding the case has lawyers reluctant about defending the accused. An inexperienced advocate with a speech disability agrees to take up the case despite the stiff opposition and ridicule from his association. It is now up to them to build their defence and prove that the man accused of committing the crime did not do it.

data.title: Pattathu Arasan

An eco-warrior decides to fight for their cause at a time when nobody else would.

What should have been a day of somber mourning breaks Into a complete bedlam as the two sons try to conduct the funeral as discreetly as possible. Forced to navigate nosy relatives, hidden family secrets, and their own strained relationship with their father, the brothers must hold it all together—or risk letting everything unravel.

However, an obsessed fan takes her sister and nieces hostage, demanding she only hosts the show for him. To protect her family and keep her show going, Priya must navigate a perilous struggle against the psycho's twisted game.

data.title: Theedhum Nandrum

But fate intervenes — an old man discovers the infant and decides to raise him as his own. The child, named Kittu,After the old man’s death, Kittu is left to fend for himself,determined to confront his mother’s killer.

data.title: See Saw
data.overview: Inspector Mugilan is a police officer at the Chettipalayam Police Station in Coimbatore.  Aadhavan is a prominent businessman from Coimbatore; his wife is Malavika. The case reaches Inspector Mugilan when Aadhavan’s domestic servant is murdered while Adhavan and Malavika are missing.  The story follows Inspector Mugilan as he investigates the case, uncovering the reasons behind the murder and identifying the culprit.

data.title: Nandhan
data.overview: An Underdog of a Rural village survives as much as obstacles that he can to overcome his societal status

data.title: Enjoy
data.overview: The domination of social media which paves the way for opportunities for everyone to express their thoughts and opinions freely not only provided vast benefit to the audience but it also created waves of disaster in the society.  To present themselves with fashion and prestigious gadgets,  few youngsters step into this new technological world with the intention changing their lives overnight. Was this actually an opportunity to transform their lives or absolute disaster waiting in the dark shades is the story of ENJOY that will reveal.  A strong social message and multitude of complications intertwined in the story, the director chose adult comedy with intense materials of laughter through youngster’s language of new technological era.  The movie will make you laugh, cry and reshape your belief of the current events happening in everyone's home.

Can the couple able to navigate these challenges and confronts opposition from their family and society and lead a peaceful life?

data.title: Lakshmikanthan Kolai Vazhakku
data.overview: A young man convicted of murder awaits execution, while a conflicted judge, an aging hangman, and a morally torn jailer confront the weight of justice, guilt, and humanity in the final hours before dawn.

data.title: Rocket Driver
data.overview: An autorickshaw driver frequently expresses discontent with life's aspects but harbors an ambitious dream of changing the world, though his actions fail to align with his aspirations.

data.title: D Block
data.overview: A young engineering student along with his friends unravels the mystery around his college where several girls go missing and dead.

data.title: Guts
data.overview: A son honors his mothers wish by leads life of an honest cop down a righteous path, where his every moral choice integrity invites relentless adversaries. Can he endure them and uphold justice?

data.title: Narkarappor
data.overview: Based on the game of Chess that delves into the conflicts and confrontations of people between the rich and poor class and high and low strata of society. How does an ordinary boy, from the community of sanitation workers, become a grandmaster?

data.title: Akku
data.overview: A Sequence of Murder is taking Place surrounding Hero and most importantly the victims are all close to him. Hero is searching the Culprit & Police Inspector also does the same since its his duty. At one point Police focus shift towards the Hero since situation makes Cop to suspect the Hero. Hero argues with Police Inspector and escaped to find the real Culprit. Cop chases Hero & Hero Chases unknown Culprit . We will find out the Twist in Silver Screen whether Cop Catches Hero or Hero identified the Real Culprit.

data.title: Teenz
data.overview: Teenz, a Thrilling Adventure, directed by the genre-breaking film maker and national award winner, Radhakrishnan Parthiban, is a compelling film centered around a spirited group of thirteen teenagers.

data.title: Gurumoorthi
data.overview: An honest cop tries to track down a suitcase filled with ₹5 crore worth of unaccounted cash that belongs to a businessman. With at least a dozen individuals after it, can he recover it before it falls into the wrong hands?

data.title: Azhagiya Kanne
data.overview: An aspiring filmmaker marries a girl who belongs to a different community. Can they lead a peaceful life after?

data.title: Rathasaatchi
data.overview: When a young Naxal Revolutionary (Activist) and a Policeman, from contrasting walks of life, meet at a point, it creates an extraordinary moment. An important question is being asked, which turnarounds the whole perspective.

data.title: Garudan
data.overview: Set in Theni, a minister’s greed to seize temple land sets in motion a chain of events that pits two childhood friends, Aadhi and Karuna against each other, Chokkan, who is their trusted confidant whose loyalty is tested in the tale of betrayal and retribution.

data.title: Idi Minnal Kadhal
data.overview: The story is spun with guilt and repentance of the characters and unknowingly they undo the wrong that they all had done against each other in the aftermath of an accident. They all realize that rarer action is in virtue than vengeance.

data.title: Kalvan
data.overview: In his pursuit of employment, a reformed thief encounters a setback and seeks an elderly man who then becomes the linchpin in his journey toward a fresh start.

data.title: Tik Tok
data.overview: Three friends starting a business are haunted by a ghost who wants to know his killer. They must solve the mystery to save their lives and their venture.

data.title: Naadu
data.overview: An urban educated doctor who is transferred to a village in the hopes of mitigating the frequent illness and illness and disease spread in the rural area and her efforts to get adjusted to the ways of villagers.

data.title: Game of Loans
data.overview: Over the course of a single day, a jobless compulsive gambler finds his world spiraling out of control when a noise at his door draws him into a dangerous confrontation that blurs the line between debt and survival. The film follows Daniel, a jobless compulsive gambler whose life revolves around the instant gratification of online betting. One seemingly ordinary day, while his wife and child are away, Daniel’s monotonous gambling routine is interrupted by a sharp, unexplained noise at his doorstep. What begins as mild curiosity spirals into a tense and unpredictable encounter, as he is confronted by unexpected visitors who draw him into a dangerous game far beyond the digital realm.

data.title: Mudhal Nee Mudivum Nee
data.overview: A refreshing tale of a bunch of high school students, their dreams, first love, music, guitar, football, video cassettes and more.

data.title: Utraan
data.overview: Revolving around a college romance, Utraan tells the story of students whose lives turn upside down after a certain incident. Vijay gets into a series of life-threatening troubles because of his love with Nandini.

data.title: Kuthiraivaal
data.overview: A man wakes up from a strange dream with a horse tail attached to his body and begins a mind-bending journey to disentangle the real from the imagined.

data.title: Friendship
data.overview: Four college students are accused of raping and murdering their classmate. Are they criminals or innocent?

data.title: Yen Peyar Anandhan
data.overview: A short-filmmaker who is about to begin the shoot of his debut feature film gets kidnapped. What do the kidnappers want?

data.title: Address
data.overview: Address is an upcoming Indian Tamil-language action drama film written and directed by Rajamohan. The film features Esakki Barath in the lead role alongside Atharvaa in an extended cameo appearance. The film also features Pooja Jhaveri, Dhiya, Thambi Ramaiah, Devadarshini, A.

An aspiring film director along with his wife goes to a resort to write a story. When he begins writing the story, some paranormal force prevents him from penning the story. What is the mystic force? Can he saves himself and his wife?

data.title: Finder
data.overview: A pair of ambitious criminology grads open a private investigation agency with a focus on wrongful convictions. Their latest case leads them to re-examine the conviction of a fisherman accused of murdering a local Councillor. As they dig into the details, they uncover questionable events and circumstances, putting their investigative skills to the test.

data.title: Karumegangal Kalaiginrana
data.overview: Two fathers, from different age groups, are on a quest to mend things with their children, while a son goes after his father to redeem himself.

data.title: Blue Sunshine
data.overview: Bhanu, a high school teacher, wants to transition as a trans woman while working for a school in a small town in South India. Bhanu’s parents do not know that she is already taking hormone treatment for the transition. When her parents force a marriage upon her due to their financial situation, Bhanu gains courage under pressure. She starts to live as a woman named Bhanu with her friend Haritha's help. The school administration creates problems by not acknowledging Bhanu as a woman. As Bhanu struggles to find happiness after transition, she meets a student Karthik who is being bullied by his classmates for his feminine demeanor. Unable to withstand the bullying, Karthik retaliates by wearing makeup and nail polish to school. The school administration blames Bhanu for all the problems. How Karthik and Bhanu deal with the problems form the rest of the story.

data.title: Kuzhanthaigal Munnetra Kazhagam
data.overview: Aathimoolam ,a politician, battles rival Chanakya, guided by his ambitious son Pallavan. Pallavan befriends Alexander, his half-brother, in a comical clash of school politics leading to national politics.

data.title: Madras Matinee
data.overview: An aging sci-fi writer is challenged by his caretaker to write about the life of a common man. Reluctantly, he begins the story of Kannan, an auto rickshaw driver, and his family—only to discover that ordinary life holds unexpected depth and drama.

data.title: Marakkuma Nenjam
data.overview: Coming-of-age school reunion drama in which students from the 2008 batch of a convent school are forced to get back to their school in 2018 and spend 3 months to take the board exams followed by a court order.

data.title: Parallel Lines
data.overview: Two men who know each other only through Facebook share two things in common: their name and their opinion towards crimes against women. Their lives take a deadly turn when they both meet in person for the first time.

data.title: Trauma
data.overview: An Anthology Crime story where Sundar and Geetha , an affluent couple gets into a trouble while undergoing treatment for fertility. Parallelly , a love affair between Selvi and Jeeva takes a crucial turn and the entire story is interconnected with series of traumatic events planned by an undercover gang.

data.title: Mangai
data.overview: Strangers Aadavan and Mangai, travel together in a car for long hours. The story revolves around the unexpected incidents they are facing due to love and lust.

data.title: Mathimaran
data.overview: A movie that describes dwarfism with thrill and twists. The film explores themes of love, resilience, and mystery

data.title: Thozhar Cheguevara
data.overview: An innocent boy hailing from a village is struck by an unfortunate incident, which webs him in conflicts that endanger his life and his community under threat. His idyllic life is shattered, deftly turning his world upside down. A bounty is announced on the boy's name to kill him on the same night. Whether he can recoup and overcome the labyrinth of conflicts forms the crux of the story

data.title: Hero Friend-U
data.overview: 'Hero Friend-U' is a new age rom-com entertainer centered around the everlasting global pandemic 'Friendzone'. The film will be released in Malaysian cinemas nationwide soon.

data.title: Mughizh
data.overview: A girl who is scared of dogs gets a puppy, which helps her overcome her fear, and teaches her about life and loss.

data.title: Marutha
data.overview: Two families are torn apart by the custom of seimurai, practised in Madurai.

data.title: Kaayal
data.overview: A girl, much into anti suicidal campaigns commits suicide after six months of self-imposed marital bondage. What reflections do her death leave on her family and loved ones? This film, in a nutshell, is a journey of her ashes from Pondicherry to Dhanushkodj  to be immersed by her family. The boy with whom she had been in love joins the journey at a juncture and what happens then is the film.

data.title: The Road
data.overview: A woman who loses her loved ones in a road accident realises that it was orchestrated and decides to track down the person responsible for the tragedy.

data.title: B.Selvi & Daughters
data.overview: B. Selvi & Daughters is the story of Selvi, a 50-year old woman in Chennai, India who is trying to get her fledgling online saree store off the ground. Like any Good Indian Mother, Selvi gave up her career aspirations for family life, and left all major decisions to her husband. Now, a year after his death, Selvi has taken her hobby of selling sarees door-to-door to the next level via Whatsapp, and is struggling with the confidence to build it into a real business. When Kavitha - Selvi's fiercely independent, idealistic daughter comes home for Pongal - she discovers her mother's secret with pleasant surprise, and runs an ad for the sari business without consulting her. Now, with close to a hundred orders to fulfill overnight, Selvi is overwhelmed. Can she do this? Is she capable of handling a business on her own? She needs to take the plunge in order to find out.

data.title: Sinam
data.overview: She was forced into prostitution. She is considered less than human. She is full of anger. Now she recounts her brutal life story to a documentary filmmaker.

data.title: Dagaalty
data.overview: A conman tries to save an innocent girl from the clutches of a womanizer after realizing that he had fallen in love with her.

data.title: Indha Nilai Maarum
data.overview: Indha Nilai Maarum (English: This situation will change) is a 2020 Tamil-language thriller film directed by Arunkanth V in his directorial debut. The film features Ashwin Kumar Lakshmikanthan, Ramkumar and Nivedhithaa Sathish in the lead roles.

data.title: Witness
data.overview: With the world of conservancy workers at its center, Witness presents a never-seen-before view of metropolitan cities and the invisible corridors of power lying underneath them.

data.title: Dinasari
data.overview: Shakthivel, a devoted son and brother, lives a simple life until greed for wealth leads his family into turmoil. When Shivani, a kind-hearted woman from America, enters his life.

data.title: Adharma Kadhaigal
data.overview: Four anthologies about revenge explore the need for vengeance, the effects of self-harm, and forgiveness through the lives of different people.

data.title: Paakaati Po
data.overview: Without telling his colleague, Mythily, of his true feelings, Ashwin, who fell in love with her the first time they met, manages to attract her attention. But when their new colleague, Jessy, enters their relationship, forming a love triangle, Mythily becomes jealous. The three of them must learn how to deal with their feelings, and each other, in order to fulfill their destinies.

data.title: Auto Queens
data.overview: Mohana is the president of the first trade union for women auto rickshaw drivers in the southeast Indian state of Tamil Nadu. As well as maneuvering her own auto through the busy streets of Chennai, she has to navigate a sexist and patriarchal system to secure equal opportunities for women drivers. She faces constant resistance—with conflicts and humiliations every day.

data.title: Vallan
data.overview: A suspended cop investigates a businessman’s murder that links to his missing fiancée. The case reveals money laundering through religious trusts and a hidden truth about a child’s death.

data.title: Operation Laila
data.overview: Surya, a sincere police officer, has a twin brother, Ravi, who becomes a beloved Drill Master at a school. Ravi falls in love with teacher Anjali. They encounter a ghost named Laila, seeking revenge for her murder. As Laila targets the school's staff, Surya must stop her or risk losing more lives.

data.title: Eeswaran
data.overview: A close-knit family begins to come apart at the seams due to an astrologer's predictions of an imminent tragedy.

data.title: Sir
data.overview: The people of Mangollai village like Colochi Saami and Saamikannu opposed education for the poor while people like Annadurai and Sivangaanam fought against oppression.

data.title: Super Senior Heroes
data.overview: Ganeshan, a 65-year-old widower to impress Aadith, his 7-year-old grandson, forms a pretend superhero league with his friends. When a young girl is kidnapped and Aadith expects his grandfather to rescue her, and they must unexpectedly take real action.

data.title: Kudimahaan
data.overview: A middle-class man's life takes a turn when he faces issues related to drinking. Can his friends help him deal with his issues and get back to normal?

data.title: Ambi
data.overview: Mild-mannered electrician Sundharam is mistaken for a lucky superhero after staying at an MLA’s house. The MLA tries to marry him to his modern daughter, who initially resists but slowly falls for his kind nature. Amidst chaos, comedy, and a villain’s plot, love and truth triumph.

data.title: Kadukka
data.overview: In a peaceful village, Two Young best Friends fall for the same Beautiful Girl. What starts as friendship soon turns into a comedy-filled Love war. Each tries to win her heart with charm, tricks, and emotions, but the girl has a surprise of her own is shown in a Comedy Suspense with Fun filled power packed manner.

data.title: Agilan
data.overview: Crane operator Agilan does all illegal activities in the harbour. Gokul is appointed to stop all these illegal activities. He brings in all the modern amenities to stop all these illegal activities. Agilan is capable of overcoming all the equipment and technology and continues with his activities. Gokul arrests Agilan to find the reason for all these activities.

data.title: College Kumar
data.overview: A father who works as a peon in an office strives to ensure that his son fulfils his dreams. Later, his son falls in love with a girl and starts to rebel against his father.

data.title: Andhagan
data.overview: A piano player pretending to be visually-impaired, unwittingly becomes entangled in a number of problems as he witnesses the murder of a former film actor.

data.title: Chithambaram Railwaygate
data.overview: A Tale of love filled with, friendship turned enemity, politics.

data.title: Saamaniyan
data.overview: Three young men plan a heist but find the bank already hijacked by elderly men. The public supports the elderly, exposing corruption among bank officials and igniting a wave of community fervor.

data.title: Pogumidam Vegu Thooramillai
data.overview: A mortuary driver's life embarks on a lengthy expedition to transport a deceased individual who is the pride and honour of two feuding families.

data.title: Kida
data.overview: A grandfather decides to sell a goat to generate some money to buy a new dress that his grandson wants for Deepavali. But the goat goes missing, dashing not just his hopes but those of a few others in the village.

data.title: Kaadhal Enbadhu Podhu Udamai
data.overview: A young woman's love for another woman shocks her parents, who struggle to accept same-sex relationships. As they move from rejection to denial and conditions to possible acceptance, the couple navigates the emotional fallout.

data.title: Dandupalayam
data.overview: Dandupalayam is a Tamil crime thriller based on true incidents involving the notorious Dandupalyam gang. With over 350 thefts, 150 murders, and 90 rape attempts, the story uncovers hidden truths.

data.title: The Mind
data.overview: A young man's dream to uplift his village is tragically cut short by the 2019 New Zealand mosque attack. The Mind explores the emotional journey of survivors and victims, highlighting the enduring legacy of hope, resilience, and love.

data.title: Blue Star
data.overview: The captains of two rival village cricket teams must put their longstanding grudge aside in order to take on the bullies threatening their right to play.

data.title: Vezham
data.overview: A young man tries to discover the identity of the killers of his girlfriend with only the voice of one of them as his clue.

data.title: Aag Lagay Basti Mein
data.overview: Barkat is an honest, hard-working man struggling to make ends meet alongside his wife, Almaas, who has grown tired of their modest life. Working as cleaners, the couple decides to turn to petty crime in hopes of improving their financial situation. What begins as small, calculated risks soon spirals into something far bigger, drawing the couple into the world of seasoned criminals. As guns, chases, and escalating chaos enter their lives, Barkat and Almaas find their domestic relationship increasingly entangled with crime and danger. Blending dark comedy with crime drama, the story explores ambition, greed, and the unintended consequences of trying to take shortcuts to a better life

data.title: Showgirls of Pakistan
data.overview: Enter the universe of three mujra dancers in Pakistan as they dodge state censorship and violence to vie for stardom.

data.title: 5 Stars
data.overview: A young woman flees her home and spends a bitter-sweet evening riding around on a motorcycle taxi. She finds comfort in the poetry of her (short-lived) escape and the young driver gives her a glimmer of hope.

data.title: Joyland
data.overview: As a patriarchal family yearns for the birth of a son to continue their family line, their youngest son secretly joins an erotic dance theatre and falls for its transgender starlet.

data.title: Post Term
data.overview: Expecting their first child, a married couple struggles to find romance and connection while building a new life together in America.

data.title: Kasbi
data.overview: A middle-aged Pakistani housewife, in search of herself, hires a young, self-assured sex worker to keep her company for the night.

data.title: Love Guru
data.overview: Sophia, a talented architect has been dreaming of marrying her true love. But when a new man walks into her life, everything changes. Torn between family expectations and the stirrings of her heart, Sophia embarks on a journey of self-discovery, love, and difficult choices.

data.title: Gulabo Rani
data.overview: A young boy, Akhtar, is accepted into a 150 year old university and due to an administrative fluke, he finds himself housed in the dilapidated "Wing C" of the dorms.

data.title: Babylicious
data.overview: After being dumped by his girlfriend, hopeless romantic Omar takes on the world to sabotage her wedding and win her back.

data.title: The Glassworker
data.overview: A young glassworker-in-training living with his pacifist father finds his apprenticeship upended by an impending war and the arrival of an army colonel to their seaside town.

data.title: Paying Guest
data.overview: A man turns up on the door to inspect the house he seeks to purchase, though the tenant's tour reveals more than what he expected.

data.title: In a Hail of Broken Glass
data.overview: A young, middle-class couple struggles to hide a devastating secret and keep up the facade of normalcy as they host the husband's overbearing family at dinner.

data.title: Dum Mastam
data.overview: Dum Mastam follows the course of romance between childhood sweethearts Aliya and Bao. Heady with love and dreams of a happily-ever-after, the young couple also holds onto their individual dreams of a flourishing career in the music industry.

data.title: Baba Jee
data.overview: Kashif and Khawar, two selfish gangsters, choose to defy Baba Jee, their terrifying boss, in their own ways and end up paying the ultimate price for their disloyalty.

data.title: Treasure
data.overview: A Deaf waste collector in Karachi stumbles upon a shocking discovery at a landfill, leading to a dangerous clash with a ruthless gangster - only to uncover a treasure that changes his life forever.

data.title: The Colour of My Heart
data.overview: Zia Mohyeddin, Pakistan's most venerated actor, devotes his final years to resurrecting interest in Urdu poetry and passing it on to a new generation of South Asians.

data.title: Parde Mein Rehne Do
data.overview: When Kashan and Nazish cannot give the 'good news' of a baby to father Ranaji even after 3 years of their marriage, all hell breaks loose and the couple's relationship is put to the test.

data.title: Khan Tumhara
data.overview: A genre blend of action sequences with romance and drama, centering on the character Yusuf Khan, described as navigating power, love and vengeance.

data.title: Poppay Ki Wedding
data.overview: A contemporary boy returns to his traditional hometown for his sister's wedding, soon discovering his own proposal finalized with a girl he's never seen. Challenging family customs, his sole mission is to at least see the face of his future bride-to-be.

data.title: Circus
data.overview: A glimpse in the life of a roadside mascot costume artist.

data.title: Gahvara
data.overview: To fulfill his grandmother's last wish, Farhan makes a new funeral bier (gahvara) to take her body to the burial ground. But the events that happen thereafter change Farhan's life and perspective forever.

data.title: Ruposh
data.overview: Ruposh is a passionate and soul-stirring tale of romance that perfectly embodies the agonizing pain suffered in love. As the feeling of love slowly escalates into obsession, sorrow and grief are destined to follow.

data.title: Ghost School
data.overview: Rabia, a ten-year-old Pakistani girl sets out to find why her only school in the village is closed. This fable is a ghost story with a tinge of magical-realism that explores corruption from a child's perspective.

data.title: Romantic Razia
data.overview: ROMANTIC RAZIA SYNOPSIS Razia is a beautiful and innocent girl who is fond of living in dreams and fantasies of her own. Among many of her small and insignificant wishes is her dream of visiting Swat for her honeymoon. Many of her marriage proposals have been rejected in the past due to her immature and naive nature. While on the other side is Rameez, a young and handsome man whose family is in search of a perfect life partner for him. As Rameez and Razia's paths cross and after they share a bittersweet moment problems begin to resurface. Will Razia and Rameez be able to clear the misunderstandings?

data.title: Neelofar
data.overview: A writer touched by tragedy that has prevented him producing a follow-up to his celebrated first novel gains a new perspective on life when he meets a blind woman who is unaware as to who he is.

data.title: Jujji
data.overview: Two officers—one idealistic, one cynical —pursue a brutal serial killer. As they close in on the elusive Jujji, their inner conflicts rise to the surface, exposing inner demons and challenging their notions of justice and morality.

data.title: Bhashaili (Adrift)
data.overview: Bhashaili tells the story of Pakistani Bengali’s living in Karachi, many of whom face issues around citizenship and Statelessness despite being in their fourth generation. We follow the everyday stories of young and old Pakistani Bengalis as they chase their dreams, find love, stand up for injustices, and face despair around their lack of recognition in Pakistan.

data.title: Beyond the Wetlands
data.overview: Two researchers from Karachi arrive at Hushe Valley near the K2 mountain for a research project on global warming. When one of the researcher vanishes into the cold and treacherous valley, a search and rescue mission is organized to find the missing person.

data.title: Aar Paar
data.overview: Aar Paar is a Pakistani film about Kamal and Arman's unbreakable friendship that gets tested when Kamal's wife, Sara, receives threatening calls.

data.title: Tich Button
data.overview: TICH BUTTON is a Family Drama which involves hilarious situations as certain events unveil the best characteristics of a joint Punjabi family.  The protagonist of the story, “Kaka” helps “Saqib” when he refuses to marry his cousin “Shakeela”. As a result of this refusal, complications kick in and a pile of lies generate. As the story unfolds, “Leena” a girl from Turkey enters this triangle. She gets pleasantly surprised by the Punjabi Joint family system and her heart is falling for love.

data.title: Kamli
data.overview: A young married woman, who lives with her blind sister-in-law, has been waiting eight years for her husband to return home. One day she is about to drown in the nearby pond when a mysterious wanderer named Amaltas rescues her, unexpectedly changing her life and putting her in a dilemma between her husband and her savior. Will she be able to restrain the force of desire or will she give in to temptation?

data.title: No Beloved
data.overview: 50-year-old Ehsaan runs a tea stall in Krishan Nagar, Lahore. He is a quiet person, disinterested in life, with no social interaction - whether with customers at the stall, or with his family at home. For some time, he has been noticing a male couple, who have become regular customers at his tea stall. Their casual behaviour makes him very disturbed and angry. One day, this anger manifests as a violent reaction, leaving Ehsan in a mix of guilt and nostalgia.

data.title: Sadpara The Mountaineer
data.overview: The film is based on the expedition of mountaineer Muhammad Ali Sadpara to K2 in Pakistan, which cost him his life in 2021 at the age of 45. The film opens with him passing the bottleneck with his companions, successfully climbing it, and then returning when he is caught in an avalanche or storm and ultimately loses his life. As his life fades from memory, the film shifts to flashbacks as he recalls the events of his life.

data.title: Deemak
data.overview: A family faces disturbing paranormal events that strain the bond between a mother-in-law and daughter-in-law, forcing them to confront whether the real horror is supernatural-or within their own home. Inspired by true events.

data.title: Cin-E-Rama
data.overview: A film critic is tasked with documenting an old cinema before its permanent closure.

data.title: UmroAyyar - A New Beginning
data.overview: Umru Ayyar is an 80's-90's hero character from the very famous story Talism Hoshruba & Dastaan-e-Amir Hamza.

data.title: Zombeid
data.overview: A couple Stuck in a down park on Chand Raat with zombies, must keep them contained to save Eid.

data.title: Sandstorm
data.overview: Zara, a schoolgirl in Karachi, shares a sensual dance video with her virtual boyfriend, who then blackmails her. Caught between his manipulative behaviour and the desire to experience love on her own terms, Zara searches for the strength to reject the confines of a patriarchal society.

data.title: Ghabrana Nahi Hai
data.overview: Ghabrana Nahi Hai is a rom-com with some action sequences. It’s a love triangle but not in the traditional sense. Saba is seen romancing Zahid while on the other hand, she seems to be in love with Jibran.

data.title: Holy Rights
data.overview: Filmed over four years, Holy Rights relates the struggles of Safia—a deeply religious Muslim woman from Bhopal—against the patriarchal mindset of the interpreters of Sharia law, which she believes denies women within her community equality and justice. Safia joins a programme that trains women as Qazis—Muslim clerics, traditionally male, who administer the law. As she passes through uncharted territory, Safia faces the tensions that accompany the act of owning her own narrative. After several other women join the programme, the film examines the arbitrary nature of triple talaq (instant divorce by saying “talaq” thrice). It also documents the fight to break free from both patronising voices within Muslim women’s communities, and outside forces that seek to appropriate their movement for political gain.

data.title: The Silence After The Storm
data.overview: A documentary highlighting the impact of floods on education in Sindh, Pakistan.

data.title: Psycho
data.overview: A psychological thriller exploring the fragile boundary between perception and reality, where characters confront their inner demons and moral conflicts while navigating suspense-driven events that challenge identity, truth, and human nature.

data.title: White Snow
data.overview: Set in and around Kargil, a Muslim-dominated town in the Himalayas, where a war was fought between India and Pakistan in 1999, the film tells the story of Amir, whose short film gets banned due to a complaint from a religious leader, and his social media accounts gets blocked. His elderly mother Fatima sets out on an arduous journey in the Himalayan mountains to show the film in villages, which breaks her mentally and physically and brings her close to madness before she becomes a free soul.

data.title: John
data.overview: A rollercoaster of emotions, where friendship and love collide with betrayal and heartbreak.

data.title: Dorr
data.overview: The film begins with a robbery at the house of a retired headmaster, Manzoor, after which the robbers and all the victims are involved in a spectacular race that leads to life and death. Takes you to the beautiful valleys of love. During this robbery, there are some unbelievable incidents in that Master Manzoor asks her daughter Mehro to run away with Yasir for the sake of sanctity. Now begins the race of Yasir and Mehro who hide and seek to reach the base of the truck

data.title: In Flames
data.overview: After the death of the family patriarch, a mother and daughter’s precarious existence is ripped apart. They must find strength in each other if they are to survive the malevolent forces that threaten to engulf them.

data.title: Chaudhry
data.overview: Chaudhry – The Martyr is an upcoming biopic action film. The film features Tariq Islam, Shamoon Abbasi, Arbaaz Khan, and Zara Abid in lead roles. Chaudhry - The Martyr is directed by Azeem Sajjad.

data.title: NAYAB
data.overview: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Karachi, where cricket is more than just a game – it's a lifeline

data.title: Khel Khel Mein
data.overview: A group of students from the colleges drama society decide to participate in a theatre competition taking place in Bangladesh and choose the 1971 war as their topic for the play Their idea is opposed by almost everyone but the students are determined to stick to their plan. However when they reach Bangladesh, they realize why everyone was concerned, now it is their job to change that perspective and not only win the competition but their hearts as well.

data.title: A Ticket To Paradise
data.overview: A Bengali man, Siraj, wins two Umrah tickets. However his excitement quickly dissipates as he discovers that his family lacks necessary identification cards to obtain passports.

data.title: Javed Iqbal: The Untold Story of a Serial Killer
data.overview: The story of serial killer Javed Iqbal, who sexually abused and killed more than 100 children in Lahore between 1998 and 1999.

data.title: Red Elephant
data.overview: LGBTQ+ asylum seekers in Belgium face an impossible ask: prove their identity by reliving the worst things that have happened to them. For people who have hidden their queerness their whole lives just to survive, the asylum process demands the opposite: total openness, total detail, to complete strangers. Red Elephant follows those caught in this cruel contradiction, many of whom have fled deeply conservative, homophobic societies only to encounter a system that requires them to narrate their most painful experiences as evidence. The film gets close to the reality of what this process feels like; the waiting, the vulnerability, the absurdity of turning personal identity into a bureaucratic checkbox. Red Elephant is a powerful story about what gets lost when the price of safety is exposing the very thing you were taught to hide.

data.title: Cats Can Teach You To Die Alone
data.overview: A phone call from Zain, his ex-lover from across the border in India, pulls Ali into a bittersweet spiral of memory, back to the night they met, filled with stolen intimacy, unspoken longing, and the fragile hope of connection across divided worlds.

data.title: Luv Di Saun
data.overview: The story follows a young man from Lahore’s inner city who falls in love with a woman facing social restrictions and personal struggles. Their relationship develops amid violence, emotional conflict, and opposition from society. The film explores themes of love, destiny, womanhood, and sacrifice against the cultural backdrop of Old Lahore.

data.title: Habit
data.overview: The story of a Pakistani boy who dares to hire a sex worker to explore his sexual orientation in an Islamic country.

data.title: Huey Tum Ajnabi
data.overview: “Huey Tum Ajnabi” is a romantic period drama film set in the backdrop of 1971. While the film showcases some of the major events of fall of Dhaka, East Pakistan, it is said to be not a political commentary and focuses more on the story of lead cast.

data.title: Bhai
data.overview: The gulf of understanding between two brothers widens amid the bustle of Karachi on Pakistan's Independence Day.

data.title: Shotcut
data.overview: Story revolves around two punjabi theatre artists, something bad happened with them and then how they get back their life on track.

data.title: Na Baligh Afraad
data.overview: In the 1990s in a lower middle-class Karachi neighbourhood, two teenage brothers, Mazhar and Fakhar, try to fast-track their growth to appear cooler. In their pursuit, they attempt to watch an adult film on VCR.

data.title: Babli & Babar
data.overview: A deeply moving exploration of the life of a intersex individual in Pakistan, capturing the relentless cycle of abuse and rejection faced by those who live outside the societal norms of gender. The film is a powerful narrative that shines a light on the harsh realities faced by intersex individuals in a rigid, binary world.

data.title: Ainak Wala Jin - The Movie
data.overview: A young boy grows up with a strict father, in a life is defined by rules and responsibility. His mysterious neighbor, an old jinn, opens a doorway into a magical realm called the Kokaf.

data.title: Money Back Guarantee
data.overview: Money Back Guarantee is the most awaited multi-starrer Pakistani film directed by Faisal Qureshi.

data.title: Peechay Tou Dekho
data.overview: It follows two friends who visit a haunted house out of curiosity.

data.title: Allahyar and the 100 Flowers of God
data.overview: Investigating a rumor that "iron ghosts" are deforesting his local area, the "Muhafiz" (lit. "Protector") Allahyar embarks on an epic adventure with plenty of laughs and drama to be had along the way. Fun for the whole family. A Pakistani animated film from the Allahyar series.

data.title: One of a Kind
data.overview: A school teacher becomes a viral sensation overnight when she accidentally unleashes her unabashed opinions on social media. This newfound fame comes with its own challenges as she has to navigate archaic mindsets and secret identities

data.title: Zarrar
data.overview: A secret agent named, Zarrar (Shahid) has gone rouge after his homeland. With time running out, Zarrar must act fast in terminating the greatest threat Pakistan has come up against since its inception.

data.title: U Turn Wala Love
data.overview: An Eid Special Telefilm from 2025 by ARY Digital

data.title: Quaid-e-Azam Zindabad
data.overview: The idea of "showing money and getting things done" is widespread. Gulab Mughal is the son of an honest policeman and grew up watching his father walk the right path, but it's not the path to happiness. Activist Jia has even worse plans for illegal money in the country.

data.title: Teri Meri Kahaniyaan
data.overview: An amazing and never-before-seen on-screen cast. And, the people's favorite husband-wife duo, Hira and Mani will be appearing together for the first time.

data.title: Bhoot Bakra
data.overview: A ghost inhabits the body of a goat in order to fulfil some unfinished business with the help of his family.

data.title: Chikkar
data.overview: In the wake of a horrific crime in Diyalpur, Punjab, authorities are propelled into action. SSP Sarmad Zaman, an ambitious officer, is assigned to the case and he vows to bring justice to Neelam, the victim. But his investigation leads him into an ugly, twisted web of lies and deceit as he finds himself close to uncovering a conspiracy with dire institutional consequences. As he inches towards the truth, Sarmad is faced with difficult choices that threaten to jeopardize his family and career - in a situation where the pursuit of justice seems hopeless, just how far is he willing to go to achieve it?

data.title: Hum Tum aur Woo
data.overview: Three friends, Fawad, Zafar and Raja Yasir, navigate love, relationships and friendship. Charming and witty Fawad falls in love with Sara, but their relationship is put to the test when Woo, a quirky and eccentric friend, gets involved.

data.title: Eid Mubarak
data.overview: A privileged six-year-old Pakistani girl embarks on a mission to save her beloved pet goat from being eaten on the Muslim holiday of Eid al-Adha, only to learn the meaning of sacrifice.

data.title: Four Fifty Five mL
data.overview: Kausar, a middle aged trans-woman, receives a call to donate blood to a critically ill boy with the same rare blood group as hers. She rushes through the busy city of Lahore to reach the hospital on time, only to find out that her blood is not welcome, even if it costs the boy his life.

data.title: Taxali Gate
data.overview: In the red light district of Lahore, when the daughter of an underprivileged wedding dancer is raped by the powerful Choudhary's son, the neighbourhood pimp and the top prostitute help the pair seek justice.

data.title: Sanak
data.overview: An obsessed stalker pursues a popular actress and murders those in his path.

Pakistan, 1978. Lenny, a rockstar from the Christian community, is offered the chance to reinvent himself as a state-sanctioned singer. With Islamic fervor gripping the nation, he must decide if he can change along with the times.

data.title: Yasmeen's Element
data.overview: An allegorical day-in-the-life adventure lived through the eyes of a naive, determined Yasmeen in search of her missing homework assignment, while the pressures of the adult world threaten her and her rural mountain village in Pakistan.

data.title: Daadal
data.overview: A female boxer from a small, infamously violent town in Pakistan becomes a contract killer in order to avenge her sister's honor.

data.title: Daghabaaz Dil
data.overview: Once upon a time, in the bustling city of Karachi, the air was filled with excitement and anticipation. Faris and Zoya's families, after years of feuding, had finally decided to put their differences aside.

data.title: Thakur Ka Kuan
data.overview: A celebrated television host is quietly erased by the very system he once defended when his identity suddenly stops being recognized.

data.title: Beauty Boxed
data.overview: Young take of a girl breaking chains out of her early child marriage to pursue a dream of becoming a makeup artist.

data.title: Murder Tongue
data.overview: It is May of 1992. The state sanctioned “Operation” has put the city of Karachi at constant unrest. Abdul Aziz Ansari wakes up at night and is informed by his daughter in law, Naseema that his son hasn’t returned home. As a knock on their door later at night summons them to the hospital, what they witness along the way is known today as the most brutal chapter of the city’s history, a sentiment of hatred towards their race, deep rooted beneath the system.

data.title: Manual 2155
data.overview: There only 12% human population left on earth and remaining is getting killed by a half human half robot Machine B4.

data.title: Remind Me Again
data.overview: Pained by grief and equipped with a special device, Changez enters his memories to revisit his love.

data.title: Karmash
data.overview: The last heir of the Karmash tribe recollects his now-forgotten ancestral traditions. He wanders through fragmented memories of his past, his lineage, and the city, which is slowly fading into the ruins of his consciousness. A portrait of a man on the verge of familial madness.

data.title: As Far as They Can Run
data.overview: Three young adults join a running program for disabled youth in Pakistan, hoping to shift perspectives in their rural community.

data.title: The Lasting August
data.overview: Indo-Pak collaboration animated film directed by Ammar Aziz

data.title: Digging To Survive
data.overview: Haider, a construction worker haunted by past trauma, struggles to provide for his family while battling painful memories that threaten to break his fragile sense of stability.

data.title: Fractured Reflections
data.overview: Haunted by guilt after a tragic accident claims his son's life, John confronts his fractured identity and blurred reality in a journey to uncover the truth about his past.

data.title: Raah
data.overview: Zafar, a troubled man ensnared in a drug deal, is arrested and taken to a police station. While in custody, he reflects on his life choices and their devastating impact on his younger sister. Through a poignant letter to her, Zafar confronts his regrets, exploring themes of guilt, betrayal, and redemption. As he navigates judgment from both society and himself, he seeks a path to reclaim his humanity and make amends.

data.title: This Stained Dawn
data.overview: Detailing the preparation of the multi-city Aurat March (Women's March) in Pakistan, This Stained Dawn tells the story of a feminist movement asserting itself in the country's urban spaces through the eyes of the march's organisers.

data.title: Aik Hai Nigar
data.overview: Based on the inspiring true story of Pakistan Army’s first female Three Star (⭐⭐⭐) General. ‘𝗔𝗶𝗸 𝗛𝗮𝗶 𝗡𝗶𝗴𝗮𝗿’  traces the life and career of 𝗟𝗶𝗲𝘂𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗮𝗻𝘁 𝗚𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗡𝗶𝗴𝗮𝗿 𝗝𝗼𝗵𝗮𝗿, a name synonymous to strength, determination and professional excellence.  Gen Nigar Johar rose through the ranks of Pakistan Army and continues to have a meritorious service. She overcame personal tragedy and societal pressures to break the glass ceiling for all the women of the country. A tribute to one of the biggest symbols of women empowerment in Pakistan.

data.title: All the Men I Met but Never Dated
data.overview: When Ali and Oliver meet, it seems like love at first sight. But because Ali is Muslim and still closeted, it’s not as simple as boy-meets-boy. As Oliver starts to wonder where their relationship can go, Ali must choose between the love he wants and the family and faith he has. And dancing with Oliver or on his own.

data.title: Her My Voice
data.overview: A short documentary/drama based in the little known world of a dancing woman. Set in the vibrant city of Lahore "Her My Voice" tells the emotional story of Komal. A deaf mute transsexual, as she reconnects with her father after he suddenly falls ill leading to a stroke.

data.title: Black Briefcase: The Nuclear Trigger
data.overview: The movie is based on the conspiracy theories for "The Third World War" that is continuing and getting very fast to the end of world. The film's narrative is structured of Nuclear War to reduce the world's population with the intention of gaining control over every human being to building up One World Government on this planet.

data.title: Gunjal
data.overview: When the killer of an adolescent labor activist is acquitted, journalist Shahbaz Bhatti sees glaring loopholes in the verdict, and begins a quest for justice. But each lead he follows contradicts the one before, and the twisted story reveals the ugly truth of child labor in 1990s Pakistan.

data.title: City of Smiles
data.overview: Pakistan, 2071. There have been no reported instances of terrorism or violent crime in over 30 years. The cost: the systemic subjugation of all human emotion.

data.title: Plum Cake
data.overview: A devout Christian mother in Pakistan is determined to find a bride for her only son, unaware that he is secretly in love with his best friend. As she pushes her traditional expectations, tensions build until the truth quietly surfaces. Set within a conservative household, the story explores the emotional fallout of a mother confronting her son’s hidden sexuality, and the quiet unraveling of the future she had imagined. It’s a poignant look at how love, identity, and tradition collide—leaving room for heartbreak, confrontation, and the possibility of acceptance.

data.title: Swipe
data.overview: A young boy addicted to iFatwa, an app that crowdsources religious death sentences, spends his days swiping on the lives of strangers.

data.title: May I Have This Seat?
data.overview: A pregnant woman tries to get to the doctor.

data.title: The Other Side: Pehelwaan
data.overview: Imran, hailing from Pakistan, works at the fish market in UAE. Wrestling runs in his family and is part of their legacy. Akhadas (wrestling ground) have been an integral part of his life and bears many of his childhood memories.

data.title: Echoes of Choices
data.overview: Adil, a young boy caught between the pressures of an oppressive father and his own aspirations, faces a conflict that shapes his world. A seemingly simple exchange with a street food seller sparks a series of events that challenge Adil’s beliefs about family, authority, and his place in the world.

data.title: Trans Kashmir
data.overview: Once entertainers and employees of the royal courts, they were believed to have mystical powers. Today they fight for dignity in life and death. This film is about the extreme hardships, resilience and beauty of Kashmir’s Hijra (transgender) community and their growing movement for basic human rights.

data.title: Gulzar
data.overview: Gulzar travels in rickety taxis, meets dodgy-looking goons, and eventually is revealed to be involved in illicit human trafficking. Over the course of an eventful night, his paths cross with a private erotic dancer and her companion cum make-up man.

data.title: Pot of Gold
data.overview: In the valleys of Kashmir beekeeper Shakeel Ahmed Khan has committed his life to learning about the nature of bees and their delicate work. However, his story takes a dramatic turn following the impact of the most destructive earthquake the region has ever seen. From the rubble, a charitable project reignites this lost art, until on the eve of their biggest exhibition to date, another, more unnatural disaster threatens to undermine all their progress.

data.title: I Am Home
data.overview: A story about facing your demons.

data.title: Further Than Usual
data.overview: On her usual running route, Farah runs into a stranger again, and again.

data.title: Kalasha
data.overview: A story about hope, God, and belief. Taking place in the Kalasha valleys, this film explores the social life of Pakistan's Kalash people.

data.title: Stay Tuned
data.overview: Stay Tuned - A journey through time of Pakistan's tumultuous history seen across the TV screen through the eyes of three generations where times do change but people have the same misguided mindset of believing the media and blaming the other person instead of looking unto themselves for reflections and betterment.

data.title: Like No Other
data.overview: Caused by a combination of global warming and climate change, the 2010 Pakistan floods were the worst natural disaster in Pakistan's history. The filmmakers go to places no one dared to go.

data.title: Sea of Fire
data.overview: The Daughter of the Moon leaves her celestial home and follows a mystical spiral into unknown worlds where everything becomes music.

data.title: Doda
data.overview: The story revolves around a former boxer DODA from a small town. The film goes through the journey of Doda, and how he can survive and overcome his past and make things right once again.

data.title: Make It Look Real
data.overview: “Make it look real,” the clients of a photo studio in Pakistan urge the photographer. They want a photo of themselves with girls, and preferably holding a gun or sitting on a motorcycle, even though they have none of these things. So their photos are pasted onto stock photos. In a sense, these studios are selling a lie, but at the same time the photos bring to light the dreams and ambitions of their clients.

data.title: Madaari (The Monkey Dance)
data.overview: In 2008, Karachi Haris Qadeer's father was brutally murdered in a political rift. The only luck he gets is at his father's killer's office. What would he choose? Revenge or a better life?

data.title: Manju Maria
data.overview: Manju Maria is the tale of war to obtain the heart and soul of a beautiful woman (Maria) between the hero (Sameer) and wild evil (Manju). Everything is fair in love and war. See how an evil goes about the limits to achieve his goals and enables the heroine to go accordingly as he wants. Sameer struggles hard to save Maria from the evil quarrel Evil. Will Maria be able to go out of the Trance of Evil, will Sameer fight with Manju having too much proof will Manju be successful in achieving all goals.

data.title: Never Stand Down: The Quraishi Family
data.overview: This warm and thought-provoking film offers a lens into the Asian familial ways of love and acceptance. For Indian Pakistani American Khalid Quraishi, his daughter Zunaira’s announcement that she was ready to marry the woman of her dreams was a joyous, even miraculous, occasion. Having lived through the Partition, persecution, and the harrowing threat of nearly losing Zunaira to cancer, Khalid never once doubted what his Muslim faith had taught him to believe was most important of all: his love for his family.

data.title: Balochabad
data.overview: Balochabad is a Balochi-language Pakistani film that addresses crucial social issues like girls' education, women's empowerment, and early-age marriages.
